mapper.select: SELECT target.membership_id, target.is_target, membership.joined_at, membership.ended_at FROM public.attendance_target AS target JOIN public.department_membership AS membership ON membership.id = target.membership_id AND membership.department_id = target.department_id AND membership.member_id = target.member_id WHERE target.attendance_day_id = #{attendanceDayId} AND target.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE OF membership, target
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attendance_target ( attendance_day_id, member_id, department_id, membership_id, is_target, added_source, changed_by_account_id, changed_at, change_reason ) VALUES ( #{attendanceDayId}, #{memberId}, #{departmentId}, #{membershipId}, TRUE, 'MANUAL', #{actorAccountId}, #{changedAt}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, attendance_band_id, band_label_snapshot, checked_in_at, source, note FROM public.attendance_record WHERE attendance_day_id = #{attendanceDayId} AND member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO public.attendance_record ( attendance_day_id, policy_version_id, member_id, attendance_band_id, status, band_sequence_snapshot, band_label_snapshot, checked_in_at, source, note, created_by_account_id ) VALUES ( #{attendanceDayId}, #{policyVersionId}, #{memberId}, #{attendanceBandId}, #{status}, #{bandSequence}, #{bandLabel}, #{checkedInAt}, 'MANUAL', #{note}, #{actorAccountId} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attendance_record SET policy_version_id = #{policyVersionId}, attendance_band_id = #{attendanceBandId}, status = #{status}, band_sequence_snapshot = #{bandSequence}, band_label_snapshot = #{bandLabel}, checked_in_at = #{checkedInAt}, source = 'MANUAL', note = #{note}, updated_by_account_id = #{actorAccountId} WHERE id = #{recordId}
